description: This file declares the interface for the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory class, which is a factory class responsible for creating instances of IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper. It includes necessary headers, defines the class within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace, and provides static and virtual methods for creating protection metadata wrappers.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory instance.

methods.name: createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates a protection metadata wrapper using the provided IGstWrapper shared pointer.
